subject: Pilot access bridge & PO clearance - request
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novatohealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access bridge & PO clearance - request

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time on Thursday. Great to see the team exercising the agent routing flows in the sandbox — the logs you shared were super helpful. I wanted to check on the procurement timeline you mentioned: you said PO would be routed to Finance this week but might be delayed by a backlog.

If the PO is still in-process next week, we can provision a short-term credit bridge so your engineers don’t lose continuity on the pilot. Before I commit credits from Sales, two quick asks:

- Can you confirm the expected PO approval date (even an estimated week is fine)?
- Can you share the procurement contact (if different from purchasing@novatohealth.com) and any PO/reference number we should attach to the internal request?

If helpful, I’ve attached a PO template and a one-page outline of the temporary credit policy for pilots. Happy to approve a 7–14 day voucher depending on the timeline you share.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: PO-template.docx, redwood-temporary-credit-approval.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir@novatohealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: purchasing@novatohealth.com
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access bridge & PO clearance - request

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the follow-up. Quick update from my side: Purchasing received the draft last Thursday but Finance has a two-week review queue right now due to end-of-quarter audits. Realistically we’re looking at final PO approval around the week of May 24.

Procurement contact is Maya Rios (m.rios@novatohealth.com) — I’ve CC’d the purchasing alias so Finance sees this thread. There isn’t a PO number yet; once Finance assigns it I’ll forward it immediately.

A brief ask back to you: could Redwood keep the sandbox run live through the 24th? The data science team is mid-benchmark and a cleanup/re-run would be painful if we lose state. Any temporary token/top-up would be amazing.

Thanks,
Samir
Senior Product Manager, Novato Health
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novatohealth.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Maya Rios <m.rios@novatohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access bridge & PO clearance - request

Samir — thanks for the clarity and for looping in Maya.

We can absolutely keep the environment live. I’ve gone ahead and requested a temporary 10-day sandbox voucher while the PO clears. Two operational notes:

- Voucher will provision immediately after internal approval (I’ve flagged this as time-sensitive).
- We’ll need the PO number or a Finance confirmation email to convert credits to pre-paid usage once the PO is issued.

Maya — welcome to the thread. If it helps, I can send a short note summarizing costs and the PO template for quick processing. Markus from Sales Ops is on copy to expedite the internal approval.

Next steps:
- Maya: can you confirm whether Finance needs a formal SOW or if a PO reference (line item + estimate) is sufficient?
- Samir: I’ll follow up Monday with the voucher details and a HubSpot link you can use to check status.

Thanks —
Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Quick internal note — approved temporary credit.

Lauren / Tessa: Sales Ops approves a 10-day, non-renewing sandbox credit for Novato (DEAL-4832). I attached the internal approval PDF and added a line to the HubSpot deal noting voucher expiration. Please provision the credit today and mention the requirement that we receive a PO number or Finance confirmation to reconcile later.

Maya / Samir: once Finance assigns a PO number, please reply-all with that number and we’ll convert/debit the voucher against the issued PO per normal order flow.

Markus Klein
Head of Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
